conv_block_stride2.description: ResNet downsampling block: 3x3-SAME conv stride 2 + relu + 3x3-SAME conv + residual via 1x1-VALID projection stride 2 (x[2,8,16,16] -> [2,8,8,8])

deep_mlp_block.name: deep_mlp_block
deep_mlp_block.description: 4-layer MLP block [4,32] -> 64 -> 32 -> 16 -> 8: relu + middle layernorm + relu

mlp_block_residual.name: mlp_block_residual
mlp_block_residual.description: 2-layer residual MLP block [4,32] -> 32 -> 32: relu + residual add + layernorm

pso_step.name: pso_step
pso_step.description: one PSO iteration: v' = w v + c1 r1 (pb-p) + c2 r2 (gb-p), p' = p + v' (static w/c1/c2/r1/r2)

kmeans_iter.name: kmeans_iter
kmeans_iter.description: one k-means iteration: argmin squared-distance assignments + per-cluster mean centroids (empty cluster -> zero vector)

als_step.name: als_step
als_step.description: one ALS half-step: U'^T = solve(V V^T, V X^T) with item factor V fixed (etl.solve)

cg_step.name: cg_step
cg_step.description: one conjugate-gradient step on SPD A: alpha/beta line search updating (x, r, p)

power_iter.name: power_iter
power_iter.description: one power-iteration step: v' = A v / |A v| on SPD A

softmax_reg_step.name: softmax_reg_step
softmax_reg_step.description: one softmax-regression GD step (explicit grads): W' = W - lr x^T(yhat-y)/N, b' = b - lr mean(yhat-y), + cross-entropy loss

e2e_train_mlp.name: e2e_train_mlp
e2e_train_mlp.description: 10-iter SGD training of a 2-layer MLP via etl.grad (runner: Python loop; outputs final loss + weights)

e2e_train_convnet.name: e2e_train_convnet
e2e_train_convnet.description: 10-iter SGD training of a small conv net's linear head, convs frozen (v1 conv-VJP deferral; runner: Python loop)

e2e_train_transformer.name: e2e_train_transformer
e2e_train_transformer.description: 10-iter SGD training of TWO simplified transformer blocks (2 heads x 16, layernorm, gelu FFN) + head via etl.grad (runner: Python loop; d=32/seq=16/batch=2)

e2e_infer_transformer.name: e2e_infer_transformer
e2e_infer_transformer.description: autoregressive decoding: in-graph while_loop attends over the sequence-so-far, argmax next token, fixed [8,16] buffer

e2e_pso_optimize.name: e2e_pso_optimize
e2e_pso_optimize.description: in-graph PSO loop (T=10) minimizing ||x - target||^2: v/p updates, best position + best value out

e2e_kmeans.name: e2e_kmeans
e2e_kmeans.description: in-graph k-means (T=8): argmin assignments + one-hot centroid updates, final centroids + assignments out

e2e_power_iteration.name: e2e_power_iteration
e2e_power_iteration.description: in-graph power iteration (T=15): v = A v / ||A v||, dominant-eigenvector estimate out
